definitions.gloss: a sad or tragic fate; bad luck that seems to follow a person through life
definitions.explanation: A literary, dramatic word for unfortunate destiny — the kind of misfortune that seems woven into a person's life rather than the result of a single unlucky event. Often applied to historical figures, tragic heroes, and the protagonists of fiction and biographies.

examples.japanese: {悲運|ひうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a tragic military commander.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幼少期|ようしょうき}→幼少期：21168_youshouki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{悲運|ひうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Misfortune pursued her from childhood, and she led a life full of hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{翻弄|ほんろう}→翻弄：09329_honrou⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、{悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最期|さいご}→最期：30329_saigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: History textbooks feature many figures who, despite their abilities, were swept along by the currents of their time and met tragic ends.

notes:
Composed of {悲|ひ} (sad; sorrowful) + ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧ (fortune; fate). The combination evokes the sense of a destiny shadowed by sorrow — a stronger and more literary word than everyday terms for "bad luck."

CHARACTERISTIC PATTERN — "{悲運|ひうん}の X":
The attributive form {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun is extremely common and highly formulaic:
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧: a tragic military commander
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧: a tragic hero
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧: a tragic king
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: a tragic genius
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最期|さいご}→最期：30329_saigo⟧: a tragic end
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧: a tragic life

These appear often in biographies, historical dramas, and titles of novels and films.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to be struck by misfortune
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: to lament a tragic fate
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嘆|なげ}く→嘆く：11814_nageku⟧: to bewail one's misfortune
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be attacked by / hit with misfortune
- {悲運|ひうん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept one's tragic fate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧: bad luck — more everyday; used for specific unlucky events ("I had bad luck today").
- {薄命|はくめい}: a short, unfortunate life — classical and literary; often used of beautiful women who die young (e.g., ⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧{薄命|はくめい}).
- ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧: tragedy — the event or work itself, not the fate of a person.
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧: fate; destiny — neutral in valence; can be good or bad.
- ⟦{宿命|しゅくめい}→宿命：07401_shukumei⟧: predestined fate — emphasizes inevitability, often tragic but not always.

REGISTER:
Literary and written. {悲運|ひうん} belongs to the vocabulary of essays, historical writing, and dramatic commentary. In casual speech, a speaker describing a particular unlucky event would simply say ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ or ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧だ.
